notes: pendulum.parse on both timestamps with defaults; the difference of int_timestamp plus the microsecond difference is truncated to hours, minutes, seconds. Subtracting the two DateTime objects (an Interval) or timestamp() is the usual route but returns a wrong span for mixed offsets on PyPy, where pendulum runs its pure-Python code, so these fields are used on every runtime. cast is only for the type checker (parse returns a union).
